entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit on this Christmas Day. My name is Sarah. How can I help you?
Hi Sarah. I... I need to make a return. I just feel so silly calling on a holiday, but I've been so worried about it.
Not a problem at all, we're here to help. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It's about a jersey I bought.
Okay, I see the order here. I'm sorry to hear there's an issue. Can you tell me what specifically is the problem with the jersey?
It's just the wrong size. I waited so long to finally buy it, and when I tried it on... it's just much too tight. I can't even ride in it comfortably.
I understand how disappointing that can be when you're excited about new gear. Let me just check the policy for you. I see the item was delivered 39 days ago.

Oh, has it been that long? I've just been so busy. I was so worried I missed the window. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for five years, I really hope you can help me. I really needed this money back if I can't use it.

Of course, and we truly appreciate your loyalty. I've just confirmed, and there's good news. That jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy, so you're well within the timeframe. We can absolutely get this sorted out for you.
Oh, thank goodness! I was so stressed. That's a huge relief.
I'm happy to help. We have two options: we can process a full refund back to your original payment method, or I can set up an exchange for the correct size. Do you have a preference?
I'd love to exchange it, if possible. I really did love the design.

Excellent choice. And since you're a VIP member, I'm processing the exchange now and I've upgraded the shipping on the new size to our 2-day express service, on us. A pre-paid return label for the original jersey is on its way to your email right now.
Wow, really? That is so kind of you, Sarah. You've completely turned my day around. Thank you so much.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, and Merry Christmas.
Merry Christmas to you too. Thanks for being a VeloFit customer. Have a wonderful day.
